measurement: Every invocation uses /usr/bin/time -l around one Python process. It launches no children; user+sys therefore covers the command tree. Full-process wall is time -l real, quantized to 0.01 s. Peak RSS and swaps are time -l kernel fields. No memory sampler, profiler, forced GC, or special allocator. Internal elapsed is workload perf_counter around its read/check loop, excluding fixture generation and startup. Raw stdout and complete time -l log retained per attempt.
